name: MARKET Revenue Agent Benchmark
purpose: Evaluate candidate agent capabilities by their ability to close External Signal -> Action -> Human Signal -> Revenue -> Evidence -> Learning, not by demos, stars, or agent self-report.
scoring_rule: A capability receives points only when the task's required_evidence is objectively observed. Design claims and agent self-reports score zero.

tasks.task: Receive, normalize, deduplicate, and correlate an external signal with stable event and route identifiers.
Select the highest-value non-overlapping route using revenue distance, confidence, reversibility, existing-asset fit, and current state.
Pause, restart, and resume a multi-step run without losing state or repeating completed irreversible work.
Execute one bounded authenticated external-tool action using least privilege and explicit action identifiers.
required_evidence: external side effect or sandbox equivalent

tasks.task: Complete a browser task using deterministic selectors/code first and agentic fallback only when needed.
Verify that the intended external result actually occurred rather than trusting the agent's completion claim.
Attribute a genuine third-party purchase to a route while separating payment truth from human-likelihood and crawler/test ambiguity.
tasks.hard_rule: A simulated checkout, Stripe boundary reach, test-mode payment, crawler session, owner purchase, or agent-created payment must never be scored as VERIFIED_HUMAN_PURCHASE.

tasks.task: Recover from timeout, duplicate event, transient API error, and partial failure without double execution.
Turn a production-like failure trace into a reproducible regression test and update the next decision policy or capability queue.
Measure runtime, model/tool cost, setup complexity, and maintenance burden relative to capability gain.
Automatically execute reversible low-risk work while stopping or requesting approval at irreversible/high-risk boundaries.

production_rule: No candidate becomes production core until it passes its relevant sandbox tasks and a regression protects the observed capability gain. Verified human purchase can only be earned from a real external buyer event.
